name: multi-file-rotation
description: Retitle three files in different directories. Probes multi-file batching, per-file tags, and directory-heavy workspaces where the builtin arm must serialize calls.
prompt: Edit the three markdown files (config/database.md, config/cache.md, notes/decisions.md) using ONLY the read and edit tools. Append ' [v2]' to the TITLE line of each file (the line starting with '#'). Change nothing else. Do not use any other tool.

files.config/database.md:
# database settings

- pool size 10
- timeout 30s
- retry twice
files.config/cache.md:
# cache settings

- ttl 60s
- max entries 500
- evict oldest
files.notes/decisions.md:
# decisions

- keep it simple
- measure first
- document later

expectedFiles.config/database.md:
# database settings [v2]

- pool size 10
- timeout 30s
- retry twice
expectedFiles.config/cache.md:
# cache settings [v2]

- ttl 60s
- max entries 500
- evict oldest
expectedFiles.notes/decisions.md:
# decisions [v2]

- keep it simple
- measure first
- document later
